actions.175-1-1: End of round: mark the next box of the track.

actions.176-1-2: Whenever an infected card is in play, it infects all persons in play (add an infection sticker to those without one).

actions.177-1-2: Spend {{goods}}{{goods}} to cure 1 person in play or in Quarantine.

actions.177-1-4: End of round, after the Black Plague: if no card in your kingdom is infected (except in Quarantine), destroy this, Black Plague and Quarantine.
actions.178-2-1: Block 1 person (1 blocked card at most).
actions.178-2-2: Once per turn, discard 1 blocked person.
actions.178-3-1: Block 1 person (2 blocked cards at most).
actions.178-3-2: Once per turn, discard 1 blocked person.
actions.178-4-1: Block 1 person (3 blocked cards at most).
actions.178-4-2: Once per turn, discard 1 blocked person.

actions.179-1-2: Discard 1 card with {{weapon}} production to undiscover this.
actions.182-2-1: Discard any card in play or at the top of your deck.
actions.182-2-1-2: Discard the top card of your deck.
actions.183-1-1: When played, you may destroy 1 person in play to destroy this.

actions.190-1-3: Spend {{stone}}{{stone}} to cross out 1 {{weapon}} from the upgrade cost of this card.

actions.192-3-1: When played, discard the top card of your deck.

actions.194-2-3: End of turn: if another enemy is in play, {{upgrade}}.
actions.195-1-1: Spend {{weapon}}{{weapon}}{{weapon}} to mark 1 box. When complete, defeat ({{upgrade}}).
actions.195-1-3: End of turn: discover the next card of the Invasion.
actions.196-1-1: When played, play all enemies from your discard pile.

actions.198-2-1: When played, discard 1 friendly card with {{weapon}} production.

actions.203-1-2: Start of the campaign: mark the first box of the track.
actions.204-1-1: Mark 1 box, left to right, top to bottom. Completing a row: {{upgrade}}.
actions.205-1-1: When played, cross out 2 productions on cards in play.
actions.205-2-1: When played, destroy 1 person or discard 3 persons.

actions.206-2-2: Discard 2 persons to release 1 person blocked here. If it was the last one, {{destroy}}.

actions.209-1-1: While this is in play, destroy the next land you play, then {{upgrade}}.

actions.211-2-1-1: Cross out a total of 7 {{gold}} production.

actions.215-2-1: Start of turn: discard 1 friendly card.
actions.217-1-1: When played, destroy 1 person in play unless you discard the 3 top cards of your deck. If you destroy a person, {{upgrade}}.

## Science

*Your scholars search for knowledge.*

Discover cards 46–53. Cards 54–63 go to the back of your box, behind your other undiscovered cards: only effects discover them.

You may now use the stickers of this foundation ({{science}}, {{iron}}, {{goods}} and a tab). Science ({{science}}) is a new resource.
